if_judge.overall_summary: The video faithfully executes the multi-scale 3D biomedical animation: a real-time 0.000→1.000 s stopwatch intro, a 120× slow-motion zoom from a translucent human silhouette down through heart, capillary, mitochondrion and rotating ATP-synthase turbines to a voltage-gated ion channel, then a reverse zoom back to the body, all wrapped in a futuristic HUD with a right-side telemetry card and upper-right ECG. The only unsupported element is the logical coupling of the ion-channel gate opening to an ECG spike, since the ECG trace merely scrolls the single heart beat independently of the ~0.80 s gate-opening event.
